jobs.title: Lead Strategy Associate / Strategy Associate
jobs.description:
What part will you play? If you’re looking for a place where you can make a meaningful difference, you’ve found it.
The work we do at Markel gives people the confidence to move forward and seize opportunities, and you’ll find your fit amongst our global community of optimists and problem-solvers. We’re always pushing each other to go further because we believe that when we realize our potential, we can help others reach theirs.

Join us and play your part in something special!

Join Markel at a time of transformation and become part of a high‑impact team shaping enterprise strategy and supporting critical decision‑making!

We’re looking for a Lead Strategy Associate/ Strategy Associate  to join our Richmond‑based Strategy team. In this role, you will report to the Director of Strategy and work closely with the Chief Strategy & Corporate Development Officer. You will partner directly with senior business leaders—including the Insurance CEO, division presidents, and functional heads—to help define Markel’s strategic direction and support execution of key initiatives.

You’ll contribute fresh thinking, structured analysis, and insight to some of the most important questions facing the organization. This is a rare opportunity to gain meaningful exposure across the enterprise while developing strong problem‑solving, financial, and communication skills in a fast‑moving, entrepreneurial environment.

What   You’ll   Be Doing

- Contributing to continuous development of the   overall strategy for Markel Insurance

- Conducting   market research, macro‑trend monitoring, and competitive intelligence   to help keep senior leadership informed on industry developments and competitor activity.

- Supporting business partners on a broad range of business-critical topics, from   product and growth strategies   to operational and organizational challenges and opportunities

- Assisting   in the preparation of   executive‑ready presentations   for the CEO, Executive Leadership Team, Board of Directors, and other senior stakeholders.

- Supporting   corporate development activities ,   including preliminary reviews of acquisition opportunities, market scans, and analytical support across the   deal   lifecycle.

- Helping drive   cross‑functional strategic initiatives , partnering closely with teams across underwriting, operations, finance, and technology.

- Building   strong relationships with business leaders   to support strategy development, challenge assumptions, and bring data‑driven insight to help them grow their business

- Providing   timely ,   accurate   support for   ad‑hoc strategic questions   from the Chief Strategy & Corporate Development Officer, Insurance CEO, and senior executives.

What   We’re   Looking For

- Relevant experience:   2+   years e xperience   in management consulting or similar in-house role (experience in insurance is a plus, not   a   must )

- Problem solving ability:   Strong structured problem-solving skills ,   with the ability to break complex issues into logical components and develop clear recommendations.

- Strong communication   skills : Comfortable engaging with senior leaders,   craft compelling narratives   and able to effectively challenge the status quo to shift the way of thinking

- Team player :   Demonstrated   collaborative ability, both within immediate team and wider company. Ability to   build relationships across functions.

- Ability to   manage multiple workstreams :   Ability to run multiple efforts simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and   ma intain   a   flexible, solutions‑oriented mindset.

- Results-oriented growth mindset : Intellectually curious, goals-driven,   motivated   and   a proactive approach to learning both the insurance industry

- Financial Acumen :   Stron g   financial modeling and analytical skills ,   with high   proficiency   in Excel.

- Education :   Bachelor's degree in business, economics, finance, or   a related   field.

#LI-SY
#LI-Hybrid

US Work Authorization

US Work Authorization required. Markel does not provide visa sponsorship for this position, now or in the future.

Pay information:
The base salary offered for the successful candidate will be based on compensable factors such as job-relevant education, job-relevant experience, training, licensure, demonstrated competencies, geographic location, and other factors. The national average salary range for the Strategy Associate position is $92,880 - $127,710/year with a 15% bonus potential.

Who we are:

Markel Group (NYSE – MKL) a fortune 500 company with over 60 offices in 20+ countries, is a holding company for insurance, reinsurance, specialist advisory and investment operations around the world.

We’re all about people | We win together | We strive for better

We enjoy the everyday | We think further

What’s in it for you:

In keeping with the values of the Markel Style, we strive to support our employees in living their lives to the fullest at home and at work.

- We offer competitive benefit programs that help meet our diverse and changing environment as well as support our employees’ needs at all stages of life.

- All full-time employees have the option to select from multiple health, dental and vision insurance plan options and optional life, disability, and AD&D insurance.

- We also offer a 401(k) with employer match contributions, an Employee Stock Purchase Plan, PTO, corporate holidays and floating holidays, parental leave.

Are you ready to play your part?

Choose ‘Apply Now’ to fill out our short application, so that we can find out more about you.

Caution: Employment scams

Markel is aware of employment-related scams where scammers will impersonate recruiters by sending fake job offers to those actively seeking employment in order to steal personal information. Frequently, the scammer will reach out to individuals who have posted their resume online. These "job offers" include convincing offer letters and frequently ask for confidential personal information. Therefore, for your safety, please note that:

- All legitimate job postings with Markel will be posted on Markel Careers . No other URL should be trusted for job postings .

- All legitimate communications with Markel recruiters will come from Markel.com email addresses.

We would also ask that you please report any job employment scams related to Markel to rarecruiting@markel.com .

Markel is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate or allow discrimination on the basis of any protected characteristic. This includes race; color; sex; religion; creed; national origin or place of birth; ancestry; age; disability; affectional or sexual orientation; gender expression or identity; genetic information, sickle cell trait, or atypical hereditary cellular or blood trait; refusal to submit to genetic tests or make genetic test results available; medical condition; citizenship status; pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions; marital status, civil union status, domestic partnership status, familial status, or family responsibilities; military or veteran status, including unfavorable discharge from military service; personal appearance, height, or weight; matriculation or political affiliation; expunged juvenile records; arrest and court records where prohibited by applicable law; status as a victim of domestic or sexual violence; public assistance status; order of protection status; status as a smoker or nonsmoker; membership or activity in local commissions; the use or nonuse of lawful products off employer premises during non-work hours; declining to attend meetings or participate in communications about religious or political matters; or any other classification protected by applicable law.

Should you require any accommodation through the application process, please send an e-mail to the  rarecruiting@markel.com .

No agencies please.

jobs.title: Business Transformation & Data Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Business Transformation & Data Manager (m/f/d)

Looking for a role that will have a meaningful impact on Operations in Spain?

Come and progress your career in our European Operations team here at Markel Spain.

We have an exciting new opportunity for a Business Transformation and Data Manager (m/f/d), based in our Madrid office in the Torre de Cristal.

This role is responsible for leading business transformation, operational excellence, technology-enabled process reengineering improvements, and strategic projects across Southern Europe. The role combines technical expertise and strong operational and business acumen to bridge the gap between Operations, Technology, Data, and Business stakeholders.

This position plays a key role in the implementation of the Southern Europe Target Operating Model (TOM), ensuring scalable processes, data-driven decision making, system integration, and alignment with European strategic initiatives. The role is expected to contribute both from a functional and technical perspective, including data analysis, systems design, automation, and technology governance.

What you’ll be doing:

- Leading business transformation and process excellence initiatives across Southern Europe region, identifying operational improvements, automation opportunities and scalable ways of working.

- Translating business requirements into functional and technical specifications, supporting system integration, automation, testing and implementation activities.

- Coordinating strategic projects across Operations & IT, Finance, Underwriting, Claims and European Data teams, ensuring clear governance, reporting and stakeholder alignment.

- Acting as the primary contact for European Data Engineers & Analysts teams, supporting the development, prioritisation and delivery of scalable data solutions.

- Working with IT colleagues to ensure solutions meet technical standards and are efficiently implemented.

- Applying knowledge of data, SQL, Power BI, Databricks, Excel and Microsoft 365 to support reporting, process improvement and digital productivity initiatives.

- Assessing project proposals, business cases, dependencies, risks and issues, recommending corrective actions where needed.

- Preparing executive presentations, decision papers and project updates to support governance and decision making.

- Monitoring progress, budget, resourcing, third-party contributions, overall delivery performance and lessons learned, ensuring smooth transition to business as usual.

- Developing KPI frameworks, dashboards and management information to support data-driven decision making, operational performance and executive reporting.

Our must-haves:

- Bachelor or Masters’ degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics or a related technical subject area. Equivalent professional experience, supported by relevant technical certifications, will also be considered.

- 5-10 years of experience in Business Analysis, Technology or Transformation functions.
- Experience in insurance, financial services or regulated industries.
- Proven experience working in complex environments and driving business outcomes, leading international and cross-country initiatives.
- Exposure to data migration, cloud transformation and enterprise integration projects.
- Strong analytical skills with a consistent track record of breaking down complex problems. Analytical approach, demonstrating critical thinking and practical problem-solving skills.
- Collaborative style, helping others succeed and building strong collaborator relationships.

- Effective communication skills as you collaborate with local and regional partners, as well as internal colleagues, across Spain and Europe

- Customer-focused approach, with the ability to understand needs and propose effective solutions.

- High standards of quality, ownership and delivery excellence.

- Fluency in Spanish and English. Additional knowledge of Italian, or Portuguese an advantage.
- The legal right to live and work in Spain

What’s in it for you?

- A great starting salary plus annual bonus & strong benefits package
- 27 days paid holiday plus Bank Holidays
- Fantastic company pension scheme, private medical and dental cover, life assurance
- There are countless opportunities to learn new skills and develop in your career and we can provide the support needed to do just that!

Who we are:

Markel Group (NYSE – MKL) a Fortune 500 company with over 60 offices in 20+ countries, is a holding company for insurance, reinsurance, specialist advisory, and investment operations around the world.

We’re all about people | We win together | We strive for better | We enjoy the everyday | We think further

Are you ready to play your part?

If you’re looking for a place where you can make a meaningful difference, you’ve found it. The work we do at Markel gives people the confidence to move forward, reach their full potential and seize opportunities. You’ll find your fit amongst our diverse global community of optimists and problem-solvers. We’re always pushing each other to think further because we believe that when we strive for better and realise our potential, we can help others reach theirs.

Choose ‘Apply Now’ to fill out our short application, so that we can find out more about you.

Markel celebrates the value of a diverse workforce that brings experience and expertise from a wide variety of backgrounds and life circumstances. Whatever your background, if you feel you meet the requirements of this role then we want to hear from you. We are also happy to consider candidates who are looking for flexible working patterns.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with all reasonable accommodations to be able to participate in the job application or interview process and to perform essential job functions if successful.
